newsitem.title: FRANCE: French policeman wounded in Corsica shooting.
newsitem.headline: French policeman wounded in Corsica shooting.

text.p: A member of an elite paramilitary police unit has been shot and slightly wounded by a separatist on the French Mediterranean island of Corsica, police said on Thursday.

The shooting occurred when the GIGN anti-terrorism unit officer was preparing to enter a flat in the town of Bastia as part of an investigation into a machinegun attack on a gendarmerie barracks last month.
He had been due to check the identity of a suspect with separatist sympathies and a record of drugs offences. The suspect and his companion have both been detained.

A 25-year-old Corsican was last week placed under investigation on suspicion of attacking the Sainte Marie Sicche gendarmerie on December 27. A gendarme had returned fire but apparently without hitting the attackers' car.
Investigators said then that the suspects were not believed linked to separatists who have recently stepped up their 20-year campaign for greater autonomy from mainland France.
